title: Federal Register lexicon (Layer 3)
description: Agency-document marker strings -> Layer-2 legal_regulatory-profile roles for U.S. Federal Register notices. Layer 3 of the universal block-label ontology: the ONLY layer allowed to carry these agency-specific field labels. Matching is case-insensitive PREFIX on the block's leading text (the Federal Register renders these as leading field labels on their own line).
$comment: Field-label set is the canonical Federal Register front-matter label block. Roles reference genre_profile_legal_regulatory.json. A new agency-document shape is onboarded by adding a lexicon, never a code edit.
